comment: Seeds that once produced a failure. The soak runner (npm run soak) varies the seed to find
new ground; when it finds a break, the seed goes here and the deterministic suite replays it
forever after. Never remove one: a seed listed here is a bug that used to exist, and the
entry is what stops it coming back. Keys match the suite names passed to seedsFor().
Interaction seeds 24301, 61935, and 608135839 exposed native OPFS checkpoint recovery failures;
their storage reductions are in checkpoint-interruption.test.ts and opfs-checkpoint.spec.ts.
Seed 3084996986 preserves the long WebKit plan that exposed excessive trace capture cost.
Seed 2654435792 exposed a compaction transaction ownership race in native Chromium IndexedDB.
Seeds from base 23 are retained above; base 24 Firefox seed 608135840 exposed non-durable manifest cleanup cursors and disposal heartbeat timing.
Its reductions are manifest-prefix.spec.ts, record-core-hardening.test.ts, and dispose-keepalive.spec.ts.
Base 24 WebKit seed 3084996987 independently exposed invalid manifest checkpoints and closing an already-failed worker client.
Seed 1349451771 exposed a fault-coverage gap: every randomized fault targeted a missing row, so no storage write hook fired.
Base 38 Chromium seed 2654435807 exposed a collector finishing and pruning a job between another collector's conflict and reread; reduced in simulator-regressions.test.ts.
The full Chromium, Firefox and WebKit campaign seeds exposed compaction planning/publication races; deterministic three-store reductions are in simulator-regressions.test.ts.

WebKit full seed 2779093776 also exposed automatic compaction resuming a shared job another tab had aborted after DDL; the three-store reduction checks fresh planning, changed revision evidence, I/O propagation and reopening.

Node soak seeds 720016, 740013, 740037, 750001 and 89 (--length 1500 --connections 6 --tables 3 --key-space 48) exposed cursors, DELETE key reads, spilling executors and write-scope reads sweeping rows outside an exact index selection; reduced in simulator-regressions.test.ts.

Rekeying seeds 800002, 800011, 800017, 800024, 800027, 800037 and 800040 (--length 800 --connections 4 --key-space 24 --rekeying true) exposed a connection's key forwards losing a forward once another connection collected the manifest that wrote it; reduced in simulator-regressions.test.ts.

Schema seeds 4, 2 and 9 (--length 400 --connections 6 --tables 3 --key-space 48 --constraints true --schema-changes true --full-text true --burst-commits 200) exposed a statement giving two rows one UNIQUE value refused as a TypeError instead of UniqueConstraintError, a negative constant DEFAULT that neither filled existing rows nor allowed NOT NULL, and DROP COLUMN refused on a table another table references. The suite's own default seeds 23630 and 53261 exposed OPFS refusing to reopen after DROP INDEX of a UNIQUE index, or after a UNIQUE accelerator was invalidated. All are reduced in simulator-regressions.test.ts.

Once ADD and DROP COLUMN reached tables that hold rows (--constraints true --schema-changes true --full-text true --burst-commits 300): memory seed 109 (--length 1500 --connections 6 --tables 3 --key-space 48) exposed an index selection reading a stale row from a folded base after ADD COLUMN, reduced in simulator-regressions.test.ts; memory seeds 116, 144 and 159 exposed compactTable failing on a fold planned before an ALTER TABLE, and OPFS seeds 500 to 517 (--length 800 --connections 4 --tables 3 --key-space 32) exposed recovery refusing a database whose table changed after a fold, both reduced in schema-change-compaction.test.ts; memory seed 145 then exposed that abandoning such a fold left its transaction active, which refused DROP COLUMN until the lease expired, reduced there too. Before the fold fix, every such seed failed with 'Full-row compaction source is missing columns'.
